instruction: Export the Thunderbird Personal Address Book contacts to a vCard file named 'contacts.vcf' on the Desktop.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully exported 30 contacts from Thunderbird Personal Address Book to contacts.csv on Desktop, then opened in LibreOffice Calc and saved as contacts.xlsx. Navigated Thunderbird Address Book UI, used right-click Export, managed file dialogs, switched between apps.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird Address Book, use right-click context menus, interact with file save/open dialogs, type filenames, switch between applications, use LibreOffice Calc Save As with format selection
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the same export capability but with a different output format (vCard instead of CSV). The agent must change the export format in the Thunderbird export dialog, which adds a new challenge while keeping the same interaction pattern.
metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting contacts as vCard format. Evaluator uses vm_command_line to count BEGIN:VCARD occurrences in the output file. Custom metric checks count >= 30.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks the right file path (/home/user/Desktop/contacts.vcf) matching the instruction requirement
grep -c 'BEGIN:VCARD' correctly counts vCard entries, verifying both file existence and vCard format
Metric correctly handles expected parameter: since expected.type='rule', get_rule returns {'min_count': 30} directly, and metric accesses expected.get('min_count', 30) correctly
min_count=30 matches the trajectory data showing 30 contacts in the Personal Address Book
Edge cases handled: None result returns 0.0, non-numeric output returns 0.0, missing file falls back to 'echo 0'
Complete coverage: file location, file format (vCard), and contact count are all verified
